no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Write one message for a pull request thread, a merge request note, a chat or a post from the same blocks, using only what that place can show", and give it blocks.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:write-a-post-for-a-place and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give blocks (heading, paragraph, code, list, checklist, image with an optional dark_url, collapsible holding more blocks) and exactly one of surface (github_comment, gitlab_note, bitbucket_comment or plain_message), capability (a record with html, collapsibles, checkboxes, dialect 'markdown' or 'plain', max_chars or null, theme { strategy 'picture', 'suffix' or 'single' } and unproven) or place (a post place whose format may carry caption_max_characters and source).
